newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah recovers slightly in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah recovers slightly in late trade.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah recovered slightly against the dollar in slow late trading on Monday after weakening in the morning on ample supply, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said profit-taking seemed to help the rupiah recover but the underlying tone remained bullish on the dollar following sustained cheap roll-over costs.
"It has slowed down a bit in the afternoon. There was some profit-taking after recent dollar rises," the dealer said.
Spot rupiah bounced back to 2,345.0/45.5 at 0900 GMT from a low of 2,346.75 in the morning. It opened at 2,343.5/44.5.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,344.75/45.25 and 2,345.85/46.50, respectively.
Overnight swap was at 0.22/0.26 and tom/next at 0.30/0.35.
The U.S. bank dealer said signals from the central bank that there would be no band widening in the medium-term appeared to have help the dollar rebound.
Offshore operators had been putting pressure by going short on the dollar, triggering speculation of another band widening by the central bank on the back of heavy capital inflows.
But the central bank has been resisting the pressure and had even challenged the market.
The rupiah had strengthened sharply against the dollar each time the central bank widened its band in the past, driving the dollar gradually down to the floor rate of its band.
Dealers said the central bank's signals, depreciating the rupiah three to four points a week, seemed to have given some impetus to the market to seek its own equilibrium.

"The equilibrium should be around the mid-point of the intervention band, but not the lower end of the dollar-rupiah band. I think the market should move towards that direction when it feels confident with the signals," one said.

Anticipation of narrowing interest rate differentials was another reason for strengthening of the dollar. State-run Bank Negara Indonesia may have triggered off the new wave of interest rates declines after it lowered its deposit rates by 50 basis points, brokers said.
Swap premiums remained under pressure on the back of sustained ample liquidity in the money market, dealers said.
One-month swap was at 13.0/13.5, two at 28.75/29.00, three at 42.5/43.5 and six at 85.0/86.5 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,341/2,533 and the conversion rate to 2,341/2,389 on Monday.
